title: Challenges in Designing Racially Inclusive Language Technologies
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark and does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on the challenges of designing racially inclusive language technologies.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is exclusively on race, anti-racism, and decolonization in language technologies.
